title: Design: A/P Unpaid Invoices pinned vendor row matches the design pictures
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has more unpaid bills than fit on the screen at your location, a long name, and an unused vendor credit {Vendor-credit-A} from a vendor return made at your location.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-58 Akal Mobile Truck Repair.
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every group expanded.
  • The design pictures "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices" (ar-ap-p3-same-on-a-p-unpaid-invoices.png) and "Vendor credits link" (ar-ap-p7-vendor-credits-link.png) are attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare the title row with the pictures.
  2. Scroll down into {Vendor-A}'s rows.
  3. Hover over {Vendor-credit-A}'s number.
  4. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report" with the info icon; the chips are those of the other A/P reports.
  • Step 2: {Vendor-A}'s group row stays pinned under the column headings; compared with the pictures, the vendor name wraps onto a second line; {Vendor-credit-A}'s Due Date and Past Due cells hold no date and no number (a dash, "—"); bill numbers and {Vendor-credit-A}'s number are blue links; Open Balance is bold.
  • Step 3: the row turns light grey and the number is a link, as in the second picture.
  • Step 4: nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped; the layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S4-R6: “While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's row (the bucket label, customer or vendor) stays pinned just under the column headings. Only one group row is held at a time: when the next group's row reaches it, the next row pushes it up and off and takes its place. Scrolling back reverses this.”
  • S2-R6: “A blank value (for example a vendor credit on A/P Unpaid Invoices, which has no due date and no Past Due) sorts to the bottom of its group in both directions. On A/P Detail a vendor credit shows its own date as its due date, as today, so it is not blank there.”
  • S7-R9: “On A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices, a vendor credit's number links to the vendor return it came from, under the same rules and permissions as a bill (S7-R6). A vendor credit that did not come from a vendor return shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R6: “A bill at the user's current location opens its delivery, as today. A bill at another location shows as plain text, because the bill page cannot switch location.”
  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p3-same-on-a-p-unpaid-invoices.png: figure "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"
  • ar-ap-p7-vendor-credits-link.png: figure "Vendor credits link" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p3-scrolling-loses-the-customer-name.png: figure "Scrolling loses the customer name" (Production (before)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Vendor rows pin the same way; re-sorting never collapses an open group. S4-R6, S2-R9." (caption of "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices")
  • "A vendor credit’s number (C-1224) links to the vendor return it came from, under the bill rules; A/R credit memos and deposits stay plain text. S7-R9, S7-R10." (caption of "Vendor credits link")
  • "Scrolled into a long group, nothing on screen says whose rows these are." (caption of "Scrolling loses the customer name")

Design note (DR-05): the design shows a vendor credit's Due Date and Past Due cells show an em dash "—". Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S2-R6 calls them "A blank value"; the dash is how the screen draws an empty cell. Cases say "no date and no number (a dash)".
